data.title: 佐天泪子 · 傍晚河堤微风里的倾身靠背
data.description: 夕阳熔金的河堤草坡上，风力发电机在风中缓缓旋转。长椅上，泪子反过身双手撑在椅背上，微风吹乱了她标志性的黑长直发与发间小白花。她微微前倾身子，鼻尖几乎碰到少年的额头，笑嘻嘻地打量着对方，眼眸里满是青春纯真与按捺不住的心跳。
data.action: leaning over bench back, wind blowing long hair, playful close gaze
data.lighting: brilliant golden sunset backlit through black hair
data.promptProse: Leaning forward over the back of a wooden park bench along the golden riverbank, Saten Ruiko smiles playfully close. The sunset breeze scatters her long straight black hair and white hair flower as she leans within inches of the viewer's face.
data.animaCaption: Ruiko leaning playfully close over the park bench at golden sunset.
